diseases.name: Tomato Early Blight
symptoms: Concentric brown-to-black target-like ring spots on older leaves
Yellowing halo surrounding brown spots
Premature defoliation starting from the lower canopy
Dark sunken lesions at the base of the stem
diseases.causes: Warm temperatures (24-29°C) combined with prolonged leaf wetness or high humidity.
organic_remedies: Spray Neem oil (5ml/L) or copper octanoate every 7-10 days
Apply bio-fungicide containing Bacillus subtilis or Trichoderma viride
Prune bottom leaves (lower 30cm) to reduce soil splash
prevention: Maintain 2-3 year crop rotation away from solanaceous crops
Use drip irrigation to avoid wet foliage
Mulch around plant base with organic straw

diseases.name: Late Blight
symptoms: Water-soaked dark greasy spots that enlarge rapidly
White fluffy fungal downy growth on leaf undersides in high humidity
Rapid collapse and browning of leaves and stems
Hard dark brown greasy patches on green and ripe fruits
diseases.causes: Cool, humid weather (15-20°C with >90% humidity or continuous rain).
organic_remedies: Immediate foliar spray of Copper Oxychloride (Bordeaux mixture 1%)
Remove and safely incinerate heavily infected foliage immediately
Apply Trichoderma harzianum soil and spray treatment
prevention: Plant resistant cultivars (e.g., Mountain Magic, Plum Regal)
Provide wide plant spacing for rapid air drying
Destroy cull piles and volunteer potato sprouts

diseases.name: Rice Blast
symptoms: Spindle or diamond-shaped lesions with gray/whitish centers and dark brown borders
Lesions coalesce causing complete leaf blast and drying
Neck blast turning black and causing lodging / empty panicles
Node blast causing culm breakage
diseases.causes: Excessive nitrogen fertilizer, high relative humidity (>93%), and night temperatures of 20-24°C.
organic_remedies: Pseudomonas fluorescens seed treatment @ 10g/kg and foliar spray @ 2.5g/L
Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%) spray at tillering and boot leaf stage
prevention: Avoid excess basal or top-dressed Nitrogen; split into 3-4 doses
Maintain proper water depth without excessive drainage stress
Use certified blast-resistant seed varieties

diseases.name: Corn Common Rust
symptoms: Small, circular to elongated golden-brown to cinnamon-brown pustules
Pustules appear on both upper and lower leaf surfaces
Pustules rupture epidermal tissue releasing powdery spores
Severe infection leads to leaf chlorosis and premature senescence
diseases.causes: Moderate temperatures (16-25°C) with high relative humidity and dew periods of 6+ hours.
organic_remedies: Foliar sulfur dust or wettable sulfur (3g/L)
Potassium silicate application to strengthen leaf cuticle
prevention: Plant rust-tolerant hybrid seeds with Rp resistance genes
Early planting to avoid high spore load mid-season
Eradicate Oxalis weed species which act as alternative hosts

diseases.name: Apple Scab
symptoms: Olive-green to dull dark brown velvety spots on young leaves
Leaves become crinkled, distorted, and drop early
Cork-like scabby brown lesions on developing fruit
Fruit cracking and stunted growth
diseases.causes: Prolonged wet canopy during green tip to petal fall stage (spring rains).
organic_remedies: Lime sulfur spray during dormant and green tip stages
Serenade (Bacillus subtilis) biofungicide spray during bloom
Rake and compost/burn fallen orchard leaves in autumn
prevention: Prune tree canopy for open sunlight penetration and rapid air circulation
Apply 5% urea spray on fallen leaves in autumn to accelerate leaf decomposition
Choose scab-resistant varieties like Enterprise, Liberty, or Honeycrisp

diseases.name: Cotton Bacterial Blight / Angular Leaf Spot
symptoms: Water-soaked angular spots bounded by leaf veinlets
Lesions turn reddish-brown to dark black (Blackarm stage)
Girdling lesions on stems causing branch breakage
Boll rot with sunken oily black spots staining lint
diseases.causes: Warm humid conditions (25-32°C) spread via wind-driven rain and infected seeds.
organic_remedies: Seed treatment with hot water (52°C for 10 min) or Pseudomonas fluorescens
Foliar spray of fresh cow dung slurry supernatant (20%) + neem seed extract
chemical_treatments: Streptocycline (Streptomycin sulphate + Tetracycline) @ 100ppm (1g in 10L water) mixed with Copper Oxychloride @ 2.5g/L
prevention: Acid delinting of cotton seeds with concentrated sulfuric acid (100ml/kg)
Destroy and deep-plow cotton crop residues after harvest
Adopt wider row spacing to minimize plant-to-plant contact

diseases.name: Powdery Mildew
symptoms: Talcum powder-like white or gray fungal patches on upper leaf surfaces
Leaves curl upwards, turn brittle, and dry out
Infected young fruits turn russeted or crack open
Reduced photosynthesis leading to yield loss
diseases.causes: High humidity combined with dry leaf surfaces, shady locations, and mild temps (20-28°C).
organic_remedies: Baking soda spray (5g sodium bicarbonate + 2ml horticultural oil/L water)
Milk spray (1 part milk : 9 parts water) in full sunlight
Potassium bicarbonate (0.3%) or Neem oil (0.5%)
chemical_treatments: Wettable Sulfur 80% WP @ 3g/L or Penconazole 10% EC @ 0.5ml/L
prevention: Plant in locations with full sunlight exposure
Avoid high-nitrogen fertilizers that generate tender susceptible shoots
Thin foliage to promote airflow

diseases.name: Healthy Plant Tissue (No Disease Detected)
symptoms: Uniform rich green color across leaf lamina
Turgid leaf structure with clear vein patterns and no necrotic lesions
Absence of chlorotic spots, fungal growth, or insect feeding scars
Strong cuticle integrity and healthy transpiration rate
diseases.causes: Balanced soil nutrition, optimal moisture, proper sunlight, and integrated pest protection.
organic_remedies: Continue preventive maintenance with seaweed extract / Panchagavya foliar tonic (3%)
Maintain regular soil health monitoring and balanced drip fertigation
prevention: Keep up regular scouting and clean farm sanitation
Ensure calibrated drip irrigation matching crop evapotranspiration
